propositions: Patch-set upload events are delivered at-most-once by Gerrit webhook but permanently dropped by reconciler when the reconciler fails to vote in the first pass without re-admitting the candidate in future windows

Reconciler cursor unconditionally advances to newest event time regardless of per-candidate outcome (error, timeout, deferred), excluding retryable failures from all future fetches because ?t1= is a server-side inclusive lower bound
A change stalls unvoted indefinitely until a manual nudge (recheck-review comment or no-op rebase) emits a new event after the cursor, re-admitting the change to the reconciler window
Three deployment states (queued behind N, stalled in backfill, chronically stuck) are invisible to users and agents because queue_depth, held_back events, and holdback expiry are not observable
Guarding test is a false green: the fake events-log ignores the since parameter and returns the full event list regardless, never exercising the production cursor filter in multi-event scenarios
